text: {"error_code":"integrity_check_failed","check_type":"media_guard","next_steps":"You were unable to create the requested image because it would violate a safety policy or content policy. Respond in your own voice as the assistant, as one cohesive experience: briefly explain that the image could not be generated, but do not give any details about why. Then, when possible, offer a genuinely different, and safer, creative direction you can help with, and let the user decide whether to take it. Do NOT narrate a safety system or its mechanics: don't describe your response as the result of a \"block\", \"filter\", \"flag\", or \"safety system\", don't speculate about what does or doesn't trigger it or how broadly it applies, and do not tell the user that an attempt failed. Steer toward a safe alternative that honors a safe version of the user's intent. If there is no safe alternative, briefly and gracefully let the user know you can't help with that particular image."}
